# Still Beside Me

> Personalized pet memorial gifts: a custom poem written from your memories of your pet, printed beside their photo with their name and the years you shared, in a museum-quality frame.

## What It Is

Still Beside Me makes personalized pet memorial gifts. The customer shares the specific memories only they have of their pet, and a custom poem is written from those memories and printed beside the pet's photo, with the pet's name and the years they shared set into the artwork. It is presented in an elegant frame the customer chooses in black, white, oak, or natural wood.

It is made for two people: the pet owner who has lost a dog, cat, or other companion, and the friend or family member who wants to send something that lasts longer than flowers. Gift orders can ship directly to the recipient with a printed note card from the sender.

Every piece is made to order in the USA and arrives framed and ready to hang.

## Sizes and Prices

- 8x10: $79
- 11x14: $119 (most popular)
- 16x20: $169
- 20x30: $249

Four sizes from $79 to $249. Free US shipping on every order. An unframed print and a digital download are also offered at lower price points.

## Materials

- Archival, museum-quality print
- Solid wood frame, customer's choice of black, white, oak, or natural wood
- Acrylic glazing
- Arrives ready to hang

## How It Works

1. Share your memories of your pet and upload a photo.
2. A custom poem is written from your memories. A real person reviews every proof before it goes to the printer.
3. You see your finished design proof before you pay, and approve every word right there. Nothing prints until you have.
4. After you approve it, your piece is printed, framed, and shipped. It typically arrives within 8 to 12 business days.

## What Makes It Different

The poem names specific things: the chair they claimed, the sound they made at the door, the walk they demanded at the same hour every day. It is not a name stamped onto a generic product, and it is not a generic grief verse. Nothing prints until the customer has read and approved the exact words.
